tail:
Bacth 62 Step 1 is complete. The single remaining defect identified in the handoff has been diagnosed, repaired, re-verified, and all artifacts refreshed.

## The defect and repair

`validate-plan.mjs` flagged one batch-62 hard error: `lem-nrqm-many-body-two-level-thermal-formulas` depended on `lem-exponential-dominates-one-plus-x`, whose home page (`finite-probability-and-the-probabilistic-method`) lies outside the transitive `requires` closure of the pair. The bound `exp(t) ≥ 1+t` was only used to get `exp(t) > 1` for `t > 0`.

Fix (inside the closure, no shared-plan or published-item edits):
- [F3] now cites the in-closure published theorem `thm-exponential-is-strictly-increasing` (home page `the-exponential-function`, which is in the requires closure).
- The normalization is derived in-item from already-cited facts: `exp(0) = exp(0)^2` with `exp(0) > 0` gives `exp(0) = 1`; strict increase then gives `exp(t) > 1` for `t > 0`.
- Step 1.1, the proof-technique line, and the first remark were reworded accordingly; no claim was weakened.

Cascade handled: because readiness hashes cover transitive inputs, readiness was re-recorded for the changed lemma **and** its three transitive consumers (`ex-nrqm-many-body-two-site-bond-thermal-ensemble`, `texp-nrqm-many-body-two-site-no-thermalization`, `rem-nrqm-many-body-examples-scope-limits`).

## Verification (all re-run after the final edit)

- `validate-plan.mjs --run …`: **0 batch-62 errors** (only the unrelated `gr-gr15-*` errors remain).
- `precheck`: all batch items clean; `rendercheck`: 20 files clean; `proof-layout`: changed item 4 steps / 0 defects.
- `content-policy`: 18 items, 0 errors; `manifest-deps`: 0 errors; `coverage-checklist`: 49 results, 0 errors; `source-fetch-check`: 8/8 stamped; `item-dependency-levels`: no batch-62 error (levels unchanged).
- `step1-decisions check`: **no open work touching any batch-62 item** (only other in-flight batches' empty scaffolds).
- `depcheck`/`fwdcheck`: zero findings involving any batch-62 item; `extcheck` clean.
- Regenerated: `pages.json`, `proof-contracts.json` (12 contracts; F3 citations now record strict-increase/addition/positivity), `cross-batch-dependencies.json` (251 rows), and the unified ledger was refreshed via `frontier-dependency-ledger.mjs`.

## Batch 62 deliverables (final)

- Pair: `qm-many-body-and-equilibrium-models` (A, 13 items) + `…-examples` (B, 5 items), orders 203/204, category `non-relativistic-quantum-mechanics`.
- Artifacts: `research/physics-cm-qm-gr-79-2026-10-11-batch-62.{pages,coverage,proof-contracts,cross-batch-dependencies}.json`, `.notes.md` (now recording this repair), 18 current readiness records, and both `library/…` pages.
- No escalations: every prerequisite is an authored in-run item or published mathematics; the only adopted physical assumption is `post-nrqm-many-body-canonical-equilibrium-ensemble` with explicit scope and source backing.

Out-of-scope residuals reported in the notes: the four `gr-gr15-*` plan errors, other batches' in-flight scaffolds blocking whole-run join gates (`proof-contract-coverage --run`), and the owner-ledger observation about the indexing typo in `thm-nrqm-identical-particles-occupation-number-basis`.
